text: ​ 🛸 NEW MUSIC MONDAY 🛸 ​It’s Monday, which means your Discover Weekly playlist just refreshed! 🔄 ​Every Monday, Spotify drops 30 brand new song recommendations tailored exactly to your listening history. It is the best way to find hidden gems and new favorite artists. 🎧 ✨ ​ ⚠️ Quick tip: Don't forget to "heart" 💚 the tracks you love, because the playlist completely resets next week! ​Go check what the algorithm cooked up for you today. 🚀

​ 🏆 SPOTIFY HISTORY 🏆 ​In case you missed it, there is currently only ONE song in Spotify history that has crossed the massive 5.6 Billion streams milestone. 🤯 ​ 🎧 The Weeknd – "Blinding Lights" 🏎️ 💨 ​It remains the undisputed king of the platform. A true streaming monster that just won't slow down! 👑 💚
